question.prompt: Three vertices of parallelogram \(PQRS\) are \(P(-3,-2),\) \(Q(1,-5),\) \(R(9,1)\) with \(P\) and \(R\) diagonally opposite. The sum of the coordinates of vertex \(S\) is:

solutions.explanation:
Opposite sides of a parallelogram have the same length and direction when followed from \(P\) to \(Q\) and from \(S\) to \(R\). From \(P(-3,-2)\) to \(Q(1,-5)\), we move \(4\) units right and \(3\) units down.

Reversing that movement from \(R\) gives
\[
S=(9-4,\,1+3)=(5,4).
\]
The requested sum is \(5+4=9\), choice \(\boxed{\text{E}}\).
solutions.title: Translate along opposite sides
